prompt: In a vibrant anime style, the bustling shipyard dock teems with life and mechanical detail. On the far left, a crane operator in a yellow hard hat leans out of the cab, looking down at the chaotic scene below. Directly beneath him, a rusted anchor chain coils tightly on the wet concrete, glistening with sea spray. Next to the chain, a small boy in blue overalls points excitedly toward the water, his finger extended straight ahead. Beside the boy, a tabby cat sits calmly on a wooden crate, watching the movement with narrowed eyes. In the center of the frame, a foreman in a white shirt holds a rolled-up blueprint, handing it to a welder wearing heavy protective gloves. The welder, standing next to a sparking grinding wheel, takes the paper with one hand while shielding his eyes from the sparks with the other. To the right of the welder, a large cargo container painted in faded red dominates the background, its metal surface dented and worn. Leaning against this container, a sailor in a striped shirt looks at a pocket watch, checking the time with a furrowed brow. Behind the sailor, a seagull perches on a railing, tilting its head curiously. Near the water's edge, a fisherman in a raincoat casts a line, his rod bent under tension. Sitting on an overturned bucket nearby, an old woman in a floral dress knits a scarf, her needles clicking rhythmically. A brown dog lies next to her, resting its chin on its paws. Floating in the harbor water, a small tugboat chugs slowly, emitting a puff of black smoke. There is no digital interface visible in the scene. There is no modern smartphone held by any character.
